title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
blurb: An encoder-decoder with skip connections at every resolution that produces precise per-pixel segmentations from very few training images.
intro: U-Net contracts the image with convolutions and pooling, expands it again with up-convolutions, and at each level concatenates the encoder's feature map into the decoder so fine detail survives. The original uses unpadded convolutions (hence cropping) and a weighted loss that separates touching cells. The steps build each operation and a one-level U-Net; the capstone is the original valid-convolution design with its weighted loss.
